config.notes: AIBT (aibtglobal.edu.au/courses/study/<slug>/) course pages, one page per qualification, text only (no page JSON). Header: VET code, CRICOS code and weeks, then Duration, Location (NSW | QLD | TAS Campuses), Tuition Fee Offshore Int Student $X / Onshore Student Visa Holder $Y (a WHOLE-COURSE price, so fee is read only when Duration is 52 weeks, Offshore figure taken). Entry Requirements: English requirement A minimum of IELTS n.n. Intake Dates: AIBT - Monthly intakes except June and December (term_months maps that phrase to the ten other months; source is the course page itself, which also states study periods January-May and July-November). Fast Course Guide: Delivery Mode Face to face ... CRICOS Code. Live pages now also show a Rolling Intakes date picker (e.g. 11 Oct 2026, 22 Nov 2026, 17 Jan 2027) that is empty in stored pages. /course/diploma-of-aviation-management/ uses another layout and gives nothing.
